title: A Mountain God Visits the Garden of Gods
overview: Kusunoki Minato discovers that he has a mysterious power when a mountain god pays him a visit.

title: The Shrine in the Mountain and the Sacred Tree in the Garden
overview: Minato plants the seeds received from Reiki, a divine tortoise, and more gods start to visit his garden.

title: Training Wind Power in the Sacred Ground
overview: Ichijo comes to bother Minato. Meanwhile, Minato goes to a special location to train his wind power.

title: Off to the Other World to Exorcise the Evil Spirit
overview: Minato goes to the other world to purify an evil spirit inside a doll, who turns out to be…?

title: The Kami Realm of Goddess and the Power to Seal Things
overview: Minato receives new power from Amaterasu for helping her.

title: Welcome to the Spring Garden
overview: While Minato trains to master his new power, a couple of new visitors appear at his residence.

title: The Key to Unlocking the Power is in the Memories
overview: The memory of the mysterious man helps Minato master the power to seal things.

title: Ancient Connection with the Neighboring Mountain
overview: Minato meets Tenko, the god of the neighboring mountain, who seems to have a history with Yamagami.

title: Uninvited Guests While Walking Around Town
